entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A species of small, pastoral humanoids who value community, simplicity and forthrightness, native to both Dominaria and Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane home to the most commonly depicted kithkin.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The fearful world Lorwyn became after the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane that also has native kithkin, who lived in Amrou Haven.

entities.name: Amrou Haven
entities.description: An idyllic country of the Dominarian kithkin, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: A collective consciousness connecting Lorwyn kithkin by an empathic web.

entities.name: Clachans
entities.description: Kithkin villages and towns on Lorwyn, which become armed fortresses called douns on Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Harrick Teeg
entities.description: A cleric who broke a curse on two kithkin brothers, beginning the Lammastide ribbon tradition.

entities.name: Talbin Beel
entities.description: The first kithkin ever to tame a springjack.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor whose voice, with that of compleated allies, tempted kithkin through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Knights of Meadowgrain
entities.description: The most respected order of kithkin knights, inducted at Meadowgrain Lawn.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that changed idyllic Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack on Lorwyn during which kithkin used and then fled the thoughtweft.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria destroys the kithkin's idyllic homeland Amrou Haven, leaving them as nomads on the salt plains.
events.quote: but after the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , their home was destroyed.

events.summary: Harrick Teeg breaks a curse on two kithkin brothers with enchanted ribbons, founding the Lammastide tradition.
events.quote: the cleric Harrick Teeg broke the spell.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, kithkin use the thoughtweft as a weapon until the Phyrexians exploit it, and many kithkin cut themselves off from it.
events.quote: Rather than suffer, many kithkin cut themselves off from the thoughtweft entirely.

events.summary: After the invasion, kithkin cut off from the thoughtweft cannot rejoin their clachans and form nomadic bands.
events.quote: These kithkin chose to leave and form nomadic bands with others who had suffered this same pain.

events.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, making the kithkin furtive and paranoid and turning clachans into douns.
events.quote: After the Great Aurora changed the idyllic plane of Lorwyn into the fearful world of Shadowmoor

relations.quote: The type is thus most strongly associated with Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
